slices.focus: Tasha presents county map with six recurring groups; program recognized as durable, sustained service line
slices.summary: In a leadership review, Tasha presents a county map showing six recurring bereavement groups fed by clinic and hospice referrals across multiple regions, with strong first-contact completion and volunteer cancellations now unusual. For the first time, the program looks durable beyond Tasha's own after-hours rescue work — she realizes if she takes a day off, the system does not immediately turn back into a patchwork. The agent helps her frame this as 'stewardship' rather than territoriality, use 'sustained service line' language rather than understating the achievement, and watch for the subtle backsliding where reliability is used as proof she can absorb more ambiguity. Tasha saves the dashboard page and county map, plans a short written note about 'what I will no longer carry alone,' and picks 2-3 key health indicators to monitor so she can protect both the program and herself.
